faq.q: How is a titanium spoke nipple manufactured?
faq.a: A typical titanium spoke nipple is manufactured using Wire drawing; CNC swaging; CNC turning; Thread rolling. BOZE CNC Ti uses precision CNC equipment with strict process controls to ensure consistent quality and dimensional accuracy.

faq.q: What are the alternatives to Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V for titanium spoke nipple?
faq.a: Alternative materials include stainless steel (heavier, susceptible to corrosion) and aluminum (lower strength, shorter fatigue life). The alternative manufacturing method is Centerless grinding from bar stock (higher material waste, longer lead time).

faq.q: What standards apply to titanium spoke nipple?
faq.a: Titanium Spoke Nipple components are typically manufactured to ASTM B348. Additional customer-specific specifications may apply.

faq.q: What are common failure modes for titanium spoke nipple?
